odors: Friday I tasted life. It was a vast morsel. A circus passed the house — still I feel the red in my mind though the drums are out. [...] The lawn is full of south and the odors tangle, and I hear to-day for the first the river in the tree.
Letter to Mrs. J. G. Holland (c. 1857); Letters, vol. 1 (1894) p. 171
